oneLine: Wow! Momo plans 300 crore fundraise ahead of proposed IPO.

sources.title: Wow! Momo plans ₹300 crore fundraise, eyes overseas expansion ahead of proposed IPO

synopsis: Quick-service restaurant chain Wow! Momo Foods is planning a fundraise of ₹250 to 300 crore to finance its restaurant expansion in India ahead of a potential initial public offering in the next 18 to 24 months. Co-founder Sagar Daryani stated that founders could participate in the round alongside incoming investors, with proceeds supporting new store openings, working capital, and debt repayment. The Kolkata-based company operates Wow! Momo, Wow! China, and Wow! Chicken, and is simultaneously pursuing international expansion including entry into Sri Lanka and the UAE, alongside scaling its packaged-food business. Tiger Global Management, Khazanah, Madhusudan Kela, 360 One, and the owner of Haldiram are listed as previous investors in the business.
